source_brief.marketing_message: Trade global ETFs with no commission

campaign_summary: Highlighting the ease and savings of trading global ETFs with no commission. Each concept leverages distinct visuals and messaging to connect with fee-sensitive self-directed traders.

concepts.name: Global Reach, Zero Cost
concepts.strategic_idea: Highlight the global accessibility and cost efficiency of trading ETFs across borders with no commission fees.
concepts.target_emotion: Excitement for global trading without additional costs.

visual_direction.description: A dynamic composition featuring an abstract globe formed by intersecting lines and bright nodes on a deep navy background; emphasizes global connection and transparency.

copy_package.headline: Trade Globally, Pay Nothing Extra
copy_package.subheadline: Access international ETF markets with zero commission fees.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.
